top_choice_rationale: P001 credits Drucker, Holst and Mojsov for GLP-1 physiology and identification of its active form, an unbroken and independently confirmed chain from gut-hormone biology to incretin-based therapies with randomized outcome evidence in diabetes and obesity. The citation scope stays within physiology or medicine, the three-laureate allocation is defensible, and the work is mature, so an award is clearly preferable to no award.
